newsitem.title: CHINA: China to invite Taiwan to Hong Kong for handover.
newsitem.headline: China to invite Taiwan to Hong Kong for handover.

text.p: China will invite Taiwan to attend the ceremonies in Hong Kong at midnight on June 30 to mark the handover of the territory after 156 years of British colonial rule, the Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.
"We will invite Taiwan people to attend," Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told a news briefing.
"But they must conform to the principle of 'one China'," Shen said.
"Those invited must uphold China's resumption of sovereignty over Hong Kong," Shen said.
Communist China regards the island of Taiwan as a renegade province and insists its rival Nationalist rulers prove their allegiance to the eventual reunification of the island with mainland China.
Beijing insists there is only one China, and that Taiwan is a local provincial government under its sovereignty.
